race.description: Anthony Wisely Constructions Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: SNITZEL TYCOON (6) looks close to a win after finishing in the money at both runs. Has good early toe so she should be right there when they quicken. PETROULA (14) was good fresh when only beaten a head at Albury, then had excuses last time. Drawn wide but can get things back on track. RUBILACE (8) returns and while she's found the maiden win elusive there are performance littered through her form that can stack up well here. Worth considering after some key scratchings. CERTAIN ECLIPSE (5) is a lightly raced six-year-old resuming for the Morgan camp. There's some solid form around him and from the inside draw he should land handy. Not dismissing.
